sql.query: SELECT m.id,m.milestoneName,m.milestoneGroup,m.timingCategory,m.displayOrder,m.isActive,m.isDefault FROM tbl_event_milestones m WHERE m.id=:id AND m.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=m.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1
